per_item.question: In Esophageal/GEJ trials, convert 'Original/Follow up' status into a boolean is_follow_up.
per_item.pred_sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN "Clinical setting" = 'Neoadjuvant' THEN 1
    WHEN "Clinical setting" = 'Maintenance' THEN 1
    WHEN "Clinical setting" = 'Metastatic+recurrent (unresectable)' THEN 1
    WHEN "Clinical setting" = 'Adjuvant' THEN 0
    WHEN "Clinical setting" = 'Relapsed/refractory' THEN 0
    ELSE 0
  END AS "is_follow_up"
FROM "clinical_trials"
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Esophageal/GEJ'
